economics_market_realism_disclosure.finding: At 8 PDF pages, gumroad_digital's global market-realism ceiling is $1.00/page = $8.00, so any price above $8.00 is flagged NOT market_realistic. schemas/product.py::from_jsonl_record() would silently re-price it to $8.00 on the auto-distribution path. The founder-authorized first-sale path (scripts/first_sale_orchestrator.py) publishes the manifest price_usd directly, so the risk applies ONLY to distributor.py's auto path.
economics_market_realism_disclosure.comparables_note: The observed comparable cluster ($5.03-$38.00; 11 priced listings) would support a higher price than $8.00. The page-count policy is the binding constraint, not the market.

founder_decision.note: No founder listing/publication authorization exists for B12-005. Pricing below is derived by the standing Cycle 99 rule (highest price passing every mandatory gate), not a founder price approval.

price_history.status: DERIVED (Cycle 99 pricing rule, pending founder listing authorization)

cycle99_note: Depth is not the constraint at this volume: 3,336 words against 8 pages clears the 100-words-per-dollar depth rule up to ~$33. The binding gate is the economics page-count market-realism policy ($1.00/page). At $8.00 the quality gate, the depth rule and the market-realism policy all agree - no layer disagrees. Raising the price would require either a founder override of the page-count policy or a longer, genuinely useful guide.
